facts.business: Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd manufactures pharmaceutical intermediates (Mono Methyl Urea, Di Methyl Urea, Ortho Para Nitro Anisole, 2 Bromomethyl 1,3 Dioxalane, Uracile) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (Metformin HCL, Mefenamic Acid, Doxophylline).

capacity_or_capex.item: Plant and Machinery acquired but not ready for use
capacity_or_capex.timeline: As at 31 March 2026, classified under Capital Work-in-Progress; depreciation to commence when available for use

guidance_or_targets.statement: Intend to increase capacity of all products based on demand and plans to do backward & forward integration of products such as DMA-HCL, Ortho chloro benzoic acid and further API's like theophylline.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Plant and Machinery acquired during the year not in location/condition for intended use, classified under CWIP, no depreciation charged. 2. key_risks: Various tax litigations pending before various authorities with material outcomes but not practicable to estimate timing of cash outflows
Loans provided to directors in non-compliance with Section 185 of Companies Act, 2013

facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for related party transactions with 9 parties including directors, relatives, and entities in which directors are interested, with aggregate limits ranging from Rs.15 Crores to Rs.45 Crores per financial year for loans/advances, repayment, office rent, and interest income.
